cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

mechanism: A returns to feeding its choir pupil through disappointment, disguising shared need as another lesson until B asks it to sit and its inability to eat shows through.
confusable: Not openly accepting mutual comfort: even after sitting A offers more food while acknowledging its own blocked appetite.
comparison: Physical comforting tools versus a shared meal.
seedUse: D117 choir/soup/bowl/bread/crying; S05 after-rehearsal food discipline.
